product_overview: WorkTime is a backend REST API for employee attendance and workforce management. It supports authentication, clock-in/out tracking, shift oversight, and manager workflows for excuses and automated attendance controls.
core_goals: Provide secure JWT-based registration and login for employees and managers
Enable employees to record attendance and retrieve shift data
Support manager controls for automated checkout, excuse review, and approval
Enforce role-based access control and validation for protected operations

features.name: Authentication API
features.description: Allows users to register and log in to the system with secure credential handling and JWT token issuance.
user_flows: POST /users/logUp with valid registration data -> Receive 201 with user created -> POST /users/loginIn with the new credentials -> Receive 201 with token and user returned
POST /users/logUp with missing or invalid fields -> Receive validation error response with rejected payload -> POST /users/loginIn with invalid credentials -> Receive authentication failure response

features.name: Attendance API
features.description: Lets authenticated employees check in, check out, and view shift information for their workday.
user_flows: POST /attendance/check-in with valid JWT and shift context -> Receive 201 with check-in registered -> GET /attendance/shift with valid JWT -> Receive 200 with shift data -> POST /attendance/check-out with valid JWT -> Receive 201 with check-out registered

POST /attendance/check-in without authentication token -> Receive unauthorized error response -> POST /attendance/check-out with expired or invalid token -> Receive unauthorized or forbidden error response -> GET /attendance/shift without authentication token -> Receive unauthorized error response

features.name: Managing API
features.description: Gives managers tools to run automatic checkout, inspect pending excuses, and approve employee excuses.
user_flows: POST /managing/auto-checkout with valid manager JWT -> Receive 201 with auto check completed -> GET /managing/pending-excuses with valid manager JWT -> Receive 200 with list of excuses -> POST /managing/approve-excuse/:id for a pending excuse -> Receive 201 with excuse approved

GET /managing/pending-excuses without manager authorization -> Receive forbidden error response -> POST /managing/approve-excuse/:id with nonexistent excuse ID -> Receive not found error response -> POST /managing/auto-checkout with invalid token -> Receive unauthorized error response
